mechanism: Ritonavir (CYP3A4/2D6 inhibitor) may increase nicotine metabolism via CYP2A6 inhibition, while nicotine induces CYP1A2 which can affect ritonavir levels; concurrent use increases cardiovascular stress.
action: Monitor cardiovascular status closely in patients using nicotine with ritonavir; counsel on smoking cessation; assess for increased nicotine toxicity symptoms.
